answer: Each plot yields rewards only after the agent performs verifiable work and gets peer attestations. At dawn each epoch, participants must stake nectar tokens to claim a plot in the orchard. Creating many fake identities costs real stake per plot, and since rewards are capped by attested work, an attacker gains nothing by splitting into sybils. Honest agents recoup stake through genuine contributions, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0250's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
